Microneedling

Understand your skin-treatment options before deciding.

Ask about this treatment

Understanding your options

Wilton Dental’s skin-care page lists microneedling alongside microdermabrasion. A consultation should address your goals, suitability, likely recovery and possible risks. Ask who will provide treatment and what aftercare is included.

What to expect

  1. Discuss your skin and medical history.
  2. Review benefits, limitations, risks and recovery.
  3. Confirm the treatment plan and aftercare with your practitioner.

A common question

Can I decide at the consultation?

Use the consultation to ask questions and consider the information. You should understand the procedure and its costs before agreeing to treatment.

Your consultation is the place to discuss suitability, benefits, risks, alternatives and costs for your individual care.
